import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by Sleep Quality
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                      c=df['Quality of Sleep'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=60, alpha=0.7)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity (colored by Sleep Quality)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation (top 6 occupations)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Sleep Duration', 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 4: Sleep Disorder Distribution with Average Sleep Quality
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Handle NaN values in Sleep Disorder
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_stats = df.groupby('Sleep Disorder').agg({
    'Person ID': 'count',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).rename(columns={'Person ID': 'Count'})

colors = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(disorder_stats))
bars = ax4.bar(disorder_stats.index, disorder_stats['Count'], color=colors, edgecolor='black')

# Add average sleep quality as text on bars
for i, (bar, quality) in enumerate(zip(bars, disorder_stats['Quality of Sleep'])):
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 2, 
             f'Avg Quality:\n{quality:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of People', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution with Average Sleep Quality', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
